title: Week of May 26 — Iran deal gap up, WORB sets Tuesday
macro: Iran deal closing — Trump said negotiations proceeding nicely over Memorial Day weekend. Formal MOU not yet signed. ES1 +0.91% overnight. Kevin Warsh new Fed chair, hawkish, rate hike odds 45%. 10Y easing toward 4.5%. Oil falling on Iran optimism. Gap up open expected — gap does not mean chase. Room left after gap is the trade. If all names 15m SMI above +75 at 9:20 — move already happened, wait for flush.
